content:
We got list of templates. Need the one that corresponds to protecting alcohol with TMSOTf. The first result (reaction_id 149040) has mapped_rxn showing O=S(=O)(O[Si...]) which is triflate (trifluoromethanesulfonate) attached to Si. That seems like TMSOTf (trimethylsilyl triflate). Indeed the reactant includes O=S(=O)(O[Si...])C(F)(F)F which is trifluoromethanesulfonate (triflate) attached to Si. So this is the correct template. Template ID needed is the integer template_id (not hash). The result dict includes 'reaction_id' but not template_id. The template_id likely is the same as reaction_id? Actually template_id is separate. The search result fields: reaction_id, template_hash, retro_smarts_template, canonical_smarts_template, mapped_rxn, product_smiles, reactant_smiles, etc. No template_id. But the task asks to return template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). Possibly they refer to reaction_id as template_id. In previous tasks, they used template_id as integer. So we will use reaction_id 149040.

Thus answer: mapped_rxn from first entry, template_id 149040.

Provide JSON dict.
